'''Wings Alexander''' (Japanese: '''ハヤブサ''' ''Hayabusa'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP223|Throwing in the Noctowl]]''. He lives in [[Transit Town]] on [[Red Rock Isle]], where he runs the '''Hoothoot Express''' courier service and airport.

In the past, Wings Alexander was an avid {{pkmn|Trainer}} who hoped to one day become a [[Pokémon Master]]. His trusted {{p|Noctowl}} helped him win many {{pkmn|battle}}s, and it now serves as his co-pilot during flights. His lively past often leads him to daydream, and he can be distracted in the most important times.

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first met Wings at the Transit Town docks, where they hoped to board a ferry to [[Olivine City]]. Wings, who posed as a {{tc|fisher}}man, saw an opportunity for some business and directed the group to his Hoothoot Express airport. The group were amazed by his array of Pokémon and went onto help Wings feed and clean after them before they took off in a vintage plane. Wings Alexander even gave them free passage for their efforts.

When Wings was flying the group to Olivine City, a severe thunderstorm hit, causing the old plane to begin to fall apart. Thanks to Ash, {{an|Misty}}, {{an|Brock}}, and their Pokémon, as well as Wings's Noctowl, the plane made it successfully to Olivine City. Wings also showed kindness when he decided to help {{TRT}} when their [[Team Rocket's mechas|balloon]] was also caught in a storm.

It is distinctive compared to other Noctowl because of its small beard, a sign of its [[Pokémon aging|old age]]. It first appeared when it was sleeping in the co-pilot's seat, where it serves as the co-pilot. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} boarded the plane, a massive storm was causing difficulty. * Wings's Japanese name, ''Hayabusa'', is what the [[WP:Peregrine falcon|Peregrine falcon]] is called in Japanese.
* His airplane seems to be based on the [[WP:Douglas XP3D| Douglas XP3D]], a prototype U.S. Navy seaplane from the 1930s.
